spans.s:
निधन नि-धन, अम्, n. (in some senses
apparently fr. 1. नि-धा below, but in others more
probably fr. धन् = rt. हन्, to kill, with नि; cf.
प्र-धन), settling down in a residence, residence,
place of residence, domicile, resting-place, receptacle
(Ved.); race, family; conclusion, end; dying, death,
destruction, loss, disappearance, annihilation, (in
these senses also rarely नि-धनस्, m., see Hari-
vaṃśa 4846); the concluding passage or words at
the end of a Sāman which is sung in chorus, (several
words are used for this purpose, e. g. स्वर्-ज्योतिः,
वषट्, व्रतम्, ईम्, नाम्, &c.); the finale in music;
(अम्), n., N. of the eighth mansion; (अस्), m. the
head of a family; (अस्, आ, अम्), without money,
poor, (in this sense for निर्-धन); [cf. rt. हन्;
Gr. θάν-α-το-ς; Hib. nidh, nith, ‘manslaughter,
battle.’]
—निधन-काम, अम्, n., Ved., N. of several
Sāmans.
—निधन-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, causing death,
destroying, destructive.
—निधन-क्रिया, f. a funeral
ceremony.
—निधन-ता, f. poverty, indigence.
—निधन-पति, इस्, m., Ved. lord of the end or
of destruction.
—निधन-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved.
become final or like a finale in music.
—निधन-
वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. having a finale in music.

नि-धान, अम्, n. putting down, laying down,
depositing, (दण्ड-निधान, putting down or laying
aside the stick, i. e. not using force, = mildness,
clemency); keeping, preserving; a place where any-
thing is laid, a vessel in which anything is deposited,
a receptacle; a place of cessation or rest; anything
laid up, a treasure, a divine treasure (especially be-
longing to Kuvera, god of wealth); store, hoard,
property, possessions, wealth.
—निधानेश (˚न-
ईश), अस्, m. ‘lord of treasure,’ a Yakṣa.

निधा 1. नि-धा, cl. 3. P. A. -दधाति,
-धत्ते, -धातुम्, to put down, lay down, put or
lay into, fix in, deposit, lodge, bury; (with मनस्)
to fix or direct the thoughts upon or towards
(dat.); resolve, determine; (with क्रियाम्) to direct
one's labours, use efforts; to appoint; to lay aside,
put away, remove, relinquish; lay up, treasure up,
put into a safe place; to preserve for one's self (A.);
to deliver, intrust, commit, present; (with हृदये
or मनसि) to keep in mind, bear in mind, re-
member, lay to heart, keep close; to keep down,
keep back, restrain; to end, close; to place in any
state, render: Pass. -धीयते, to be place on or in,
to be deposited, be situated in or on, be absorbed
into, to rest in: Caus. -धापयति, &c., to cause to
be put or laid on or into, to cause to be deposited
or preserved; to appoint: Intens. (?),
Ved. 3

rd sing.
-देध्यत्.

2. नि-धा, f., Ved. laying snares; a net; a collection
[]
of snares, a snare.
—निधा-पति, इस्, m. the possessor
or bearer of snares.

नि-धातव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be put down or de-
posited; to be delivered; to be directed towards; to
be concealed.

नि-धातृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. a depositor, one who
deposits, keeps, conceals, &c.

नि-धान्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. fit for being laid
or put down.

नि-धापक, अस्, m. one who causes to be put
down or deposited; a weapon (?); burnt timber (?),
charcoal (?); the castor-oil plant (?).

नि-धाप्य, ind. having caused to be placed or
fixed in, having installed or appointed.

नि-धाय, ind. having fixed or placed in or on,
(मनसि निधाय, fixing or laying up in the mind,
reflecting.)

नि-धि, इस्, m. setting down or serving up food
&c. (Ved.); the lower part or bottom of the Ukhā
(Ved.); a place where anything is laid or deposited,
a receptacle, (अपां निधिः, the receptacle of waters,
the ocean, sea; also N. of a Sāman; sometimes
निधि alone stands for ‘the ocean’); a place for
storing up, a storehouse, treasury, granary, a nest, &c.;
(figuratively) a treasure-house of good qualities, a
man endowed with many good qualities; a treasure,
store, hoard, any collection of wealth or valuables;
a divine treasure belonging to Kuvera, (nine of which
are enumerated, viz. the Padma, Mahā-padma,
Śaṅkha, Makara, Kacchapa, Mukunda, Nanda, Nīla,
and Kharba; their nature is not exactly defined,
though some of them appear to be precious gems;
according to the Tāntrika system they are personified
and worshipped as demi-gods, attendant either upon
Kuvera who is sometimes called निधीनम् अधि-
पः, ‘lord of the Nidhis,’ or upon Lakṣmī, the
goddess of prosperity); N. of a particular medicinal
plant, commonly Jīvikā; a kind of perfume (=
नलिका); दैवो निधिः, ‘the divine treasure,’ N. of
a particular philosophical doctrine.
—निधि-गोप,
अस्, m. guardian of treasure.
—निधि-नाथ, अस्, m.
or निधि-प्रभु, उस्, m. or निधीश्वर (˚धि-ईश्˚),
अस्, m. ‘lord of treasures,’ an epithet of Kuvera.
—निधि-प, अस्, m. guardian of treasure; [cf.
निधि-पा.]
—निधि-पति, इस्, m. ‘lord of treasures,’
an epithet of Kuvera; N. of a rich merchant.
—निधिपति-दत्त, अस्, m., N. of a merchant.
—निधि-पा, आस्, Ved., or निधि-पाल, अस्, m.
guardian of treasure.
—निधि-पालित, अस्, m., N.
of a merchant.
—निधि-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. pos-
sessing treasure, forming a store.
—निधीश or नि-
धीश्वर (˚धि-ईश्˚), अस्, m. ‘lord of treasures,’ an
epithet of Kuvera.
—निध्य्-अर्थिन्, ई, इनी, इ, treasure
seeking.
निधि नि-धि. See above.

नि-धीयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being laid down or
deposited, &c.

नि-धेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be placed in or on, to
be deposited.

निधू नि-धू, cl. 5. 6. P. A. -धूनोति, -धू-
नुते (in the later language also -धुनोति, -धुनुते),
-धुवति, -धोतुम्, -धवितुम्, to throw down, give
or deliver over (Ved.); shake to and fro, agitate.

नि-धुवन, अम्, n. shaking about, agitation,
trembling; coition, sexual intercourse; pleasure, en-
joyment; sport, play, pastime.

निधृ नि-धृ, cl. 10. P. -धारयति, -यितुम्
[]
(Ved. -दीधर्), to place down or in, deposit in;
determine; establish; render (Ved.); to keep, pre-
serve; (Sāy.) to establish firmly; to conceive in the
womb: Pass. -धार्यते (Ved. -दध्रे), to be placed
in or deposited; to bend down, to stoop (Ved.).

नि-धारय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. placing in or on,
depositing.
नि-धारयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, (Sāy.) abiding in.

नि-धृति, इस्, m., N. of a prince, a son of Vṛṣṇi;
[cf. निर्-वृति, नि-वृत्ति.]

निध्यै नि-ध्यै, cl. 1. P. -ध्यायति, -ध्या-
तुम्, to observe, perceive (Ved.); to meditate on,
be absorbed in meditation; to think of, reflect on;
remember: Desid. -दिध्यासति, -ते, to wish to
meditate on; think of attentively (Ved.).

नि-ध्यात, अस्, आ, अम्, meditated on, thought on,
imagined.

नि-ध्यान, अम्, n. intuition, looking at, seeing,
beholding, sight.

निध्रुवि नि-ध्रुवि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. constant,
persevering, faithful; (इस्), m., N. of a Kāśyapa and
author of a Ṛg-veda hymn (
IX. 63

निध्वान नि-ध्वान, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 2. ध्वन्
with नि), sound.

नीध्र नीध्र, अम्, n. the edge of thatch,
edge of a roof; a wood; the circumference of a
wheel; the moon; the constellation Revatī; (consi-
dered by some as a various reading for नीव्र, q. v.)
